description.en: An open, generous layout. A clear headline and the product beside it.
description.zh: 舒展的发布版式。清楚的标题，与产品并肩出现。

description.en: Only the words that matter. Centered type and unhurried space.
description.zh: 只留下重要的文字。居中的排字，从容的留白。

use.en: Announcements, invitations, a single clear message.
use.zh: 品牌公告、邀请、单一观点。

description.en: Give the product the room. A panoramic canvas, with a precise caption.
description.zh: 把大部分画面交给产品，配上一句准确的说明。

use.en: Screenshots, interfaces, demos and visual work.
use.zh: 界面截图、演示、视觉作品。

description.en: One idea, two perspectives. A strong thesis beside its supporting detail.
description.zh: 两栏承载一个想法。一侧提出观点，一侧展开细节。

use.zh: 深入说明、研究笔记、观点论述。

description.en: A composed set of modules. Story, identity and sourced facts, in one view.
description.zh: 有主次的模块编排。同屏容纳叙述、标识与真实资料。

use.en: Project overviews, feature sets, progress reports.
use.zh: 项目总览、功能集合、进展汇报。

description.en: A single red point opens into a confident, centered title.
description.zh: 一个红点，引出居中舒展的标题。

description.en: A wide product frame, anchored by a bold title and a precise caption band.
description.zh: 大幅产品画面，下方用鲜明标题与图注稳稳收住。

description.en: A large folio, an oversized name, and an opening note.
description.zh: 大号页码、鲜明的项目名、一段开篇笔记。

use.en: A chaptered story or a considered introduction.
use.zh: 有章节的故事与深入介绍。

description.en: A wide headline meets a quiet horizon of warm paper.
description.zh: 宽阔标题，与暖纸地平线相遇。

use.en: A launch with an expansive sense of space.

description.en: Layered paper settles into a carefully typeset title card.
description.zh: 叠放的纸张落稳，呈现精心排布的标题卡。

use.en: An invitation, a collection, a new body of work.

description.en: The official mark, the full wordmark, then the final thought.
description.zh: 官方标志、完整字标，最后留下一句话。

description.en: The project takes the final headline. A red line leads to a small Hexly signature.
description.zh: 用项目名收束全片，一条红线引向左下方的品牌落款。

use.en: Give a story a sense of completion.

description.en: A paper end card pairs the project identity with the Hexly signature.
description.zh: 纸质尾卡上，项目标识与 Hexly 签名相互呼应。

use.zh: 有质感、值得保留的最后一帧。

description.en: Two paper fields meet. The shared signature connects them.
description.zh: 两片纸色相接，由同一品牌签名连接。

use.en: Leave the door open to the next idea.
use.zh: 为下一个想法留下入口。

description.en: A bold signature between fine rules and a restrained colophon.
description.zh: 大幅签名，夹在纤细边线与克制的刊记之间。
